## Summary

Integration PR for Bodh V1 (#1). The branch contains the frozen v1 contract and validator, pinned preparation and durable workspace, manual review drafts and publication recovery, freshness and anchor repair, native Overview/Changes/Findings, sequence navigation, finding triage, compact follow-up concerns, the Bodh-backed `pr-review` skill, and user-local installation/desktop integration.

The Findings screen was revised from the narrow inspector after user feedback. It separates Actionable and Follow-up entries in the left pane and uses the remaining width for selected details and source code, with follow-up text and local feedback below the source. The installed screen was reviewed and explicitly accepted; see issue #32 and `contracts/v1/EVIDENCE-32.md`.

The #35 installer was exercised on CachyOS x86_64 with Wayland: both release binaries installed under a temporary prefix, the CLI worked from outside the checkout, the generated desktop entry validated, and the installed launcher opened the native review. This is evidence for the recorded environment only; other distributions and X11 remain unqualified.

Issues #40–46 and #50–53 add ordered dependent publication, reply/thread-only plans, read-only recovery, persistent outcome presentation, freshness protection, failed-only retries, and bounded retention. Their service and native state tests pass; the individual evidence files map exactly what was tested. They remain open until this PR merges.

- #39: Changes alignment, persistent source/draft state, and full-width diff layout are implemented in 707ca10 and independently reviewed. Full desktop validation and native line-selection, resize, 947×505, theme, and diff-mode checks passed; the user accepted the corrected result on 2026-11-06, including the selected-line boundary at 947×505. Keyboard-triggered focus/selection was not explicitly exercised in that #39 trial. The user-reported changed-file row-spacing feedback is addressed locally in the current head: rows now have 12 px horizontal content inset and no inter-row gap. Full desktop validation passed. Fresh dark/light native captures are recorded in `contracts/v1/EVIDENCE-39.md`; user acceptance is pending, so the issue stays open. The fresh render did not repeat the earlier 947×505 focus/resize matrix. The #39 Changes trial does not replace #37 cross-surface qualification. Hosted core and desktop validation passed: [run 42206828872](https://github.com/kedarmd/bodh/actions/runs/42206828872).
- #15: Complete thread/comment metadata is now joined from GraphQL and paginated REST, including exact original sides/ranges, with incomplete-state handling for failed or inconsistent joins. Independent review found and fixed the gh api POST default by forcing GET. The focused discussion suite passed 15/15 and full desktop validation passed; evidence: contracts/v1/EVIDENCE-15.md. Hosted core and desktop validation passed for integration head c544bf0: [run 42210410597](https://github.com/kedarmd/bodh/actions/runs/42210410597).
- #45: Load-latest now has SQLite regression coverage for preserving six draft categories across a successful switch and preserving populated text drafts after failed/cancelled acquisition. Focused and full desktop validation passed; controlled 403 denial during latest-candidate acquisition is covered; HEAD, symbolic ref, raw index, unstaged tracked bytes and untracked bytes are verified unchanged across missing-CLI, 403, freshness-denial and cancellation outcomes. The CLI old/new view test now covers every protected draft class and verifies checkout/index preservation. Native failure/cancel behavior and TTL timing remain open (`contracts/v1/EVIDENCE-45.md`). Hosted core and desktop validation passed for integration head 2580ce7: [run 42212031323](https://github.com/kedarmd/bodh/actions/runs/42212031323).
- #46: Per-repository/global preparation and payload-byte budgets now evict stale preparations and orphan cache contexts while protecting current results, drafts, and unresolved recovery. Repeated real-SQLite preparation/import/follow-up/controlled-publication/reopen cycles include injected rollback and successful eviction; exact retained/deleted counts and bytes are recorded. Independent Standards and Spec reviews found no remaining findings; full desktop validation passed locally (`contracts/v1/EVIDENCE-46.md`). Hosted core and desktop validation passed for `c3a5906`: [push run 42219094915](https://github.com/kedarmd/bodh/actions/runs/42219094915) and [pull-request run 42219101535](https://github.com/kedarmd/bodh/actions/runs/42219101535).

## Remaining V1 work

The work below remains open; checked issue criteria reflect only evidence currently available, not full V1 completion.

- #16: All five acceptance criteria are checked. On 2026-11-06 the user accepted the tested native scope on the Changes screen, including visible keyboard focus. Current evidence covers Home/repository/search, resume/navigation, Back/Finish Review/findings empty state, and Tab focus through Back, Changes, changed-file rows and diff rows. Native generated-finding link focus is not exercised; #39 spacing feedback remains a separate follow-up.
- #19: all ticket acceptance criteria are now evidenced, including exact selected-line replacement, Shift+letter preservation, restart recovery, keyboard/focus/theme behavior, and unchanged checkout/index. Details are in `contracts/v1/AC19-NATIVE-TRIAL.md` and `contracts/v1/EVIDENCE-37.md`; hosted core and Ubuntu desktop checks passed at `d8ccf0b`.
- #23: ordered grouped publication and reply/thread-only plans are implemented and tested. Exact GitHub endpoint compatibility, the full remote-race matrix, and the integrated Finish Review workflow remain unqualified (`contracts/v1/EVIDENCE-23.md`).
- #24: read-only reconciliation, persisted outcome presentation, and failed-only retry services/UI state are implemented. The complete cross-operation restart matrix and native recovery interaction remain unverified (`contracts/v1/EVIDENCE-24.md`).
- #31: shared triage seams have focused tests, but the complete native triage interaction matrix remains unverified (`contracts/v1/EVIDENCE-31.md`).
- #33: provider-driven correction exhaustion and full end-to-end agent checks remain open (see `contracts/v1/EVIDENCE-33.md`).
- #34: broader migration/resume qualification remains open (see `contracts/v1/EVIDENCE-34.md`). Issue #46's bounded-retention criteria are implemented and validated; the issue remains open until this PR merges.
- #45: shared freshness fingerprints protect drafts, triage, replies, thread actions and non-confirmed publication payloads; actual CLI old/new view consistency and checkout/index preservation now pass, while native failure/cancel interaction and TTL timing remain incomplete (`contracts/v1/EVIDENCE-45.md`).
- #36 and #48: representative large-review measurements and justified support limits remain open (`contracts/v1/EVIDENCE-36.md`).
- #37: complete V1 workflow qualification remains open. The evidence matrix lists partial and unrun paths in `contracts/v1/EVIDENCE-37.md`.
- #39 has the reported Changed-files spacing adjustment implemented in the current head; full local desktop validation passes. Fresh dark/light native captures are recorded; user acceptance is pending (see `contracts/v1/EVIDENCE-39.md`). The earlier 947×505 focus/resize matrix was not repeated for the spacing-only follow-up.
- #47: the documented three-round bound and current public CLI/service suites pass, including correction exhaustion/preservation, fresh commits, empty results, follow-up validation, and stale replacement approvals. It remains open because no integrated provider run verifies agent exhaustion reporting or provider-process cleanup; see `contracts/v1/EVIDENCE-47.md`.

Keep this PR in draft until the remaining V1 work and acceptance evidence are complete.

## Evidence

- Hosted core and desktop validation for integration head `c3a5906` passed in [run 42219094915](https://github.com/kedarmd/bodh/actions/runs/42219094915) and [run 42219101535](https://github.com/kedarmd/bodh/actions/runs/42219101535).

- Hosted validation on integration head `317ac8324b64b769d883a329460a203c4e1bda75` passed: [run 42193080838](https://github.com/kedarmd/bodh/actions/runs/42193080838) and [run 42193089677](https://github.com/kedarmd/bodh/actions/runs/42193089677); both core and desktop jobs completed successfully.

- `CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2 ./scripts/validate desktop` passed on integration base `53e2977` with the #53 changes in the working tree; the complete output is in `contracts/v1/VALIDATE-53-final.log`. The initial Clippy finding and its correction are preserved in `contracts/v1/VALIDATE-53-initial-clippy-failure.log`.
- Both hosted Validate workflow runs for the current PR head `ecca831` passed: [run 42170202055](https://github.com/kedarmd/bodh/actions/runs/42170202055) and [run 42170196349](https://github.com/kedarmd/bodh/actions/runs/42170196349). Earlier duplicate-run preflight process-start failures remain preserved in the older validation logs; they are not treated as passing evidence.
- Focused recovery/retry evidence is in `contracts/v1/EVIDENCE-40.md`, `EVIDENCE-41.md`, `EVIDENCE-42.md`, `EVIDENCE-43.md`, `EVIDENCE-45.md`, and `EVIDENCE-50.md` through `EVIDENCE-53.md`.
- `contracts/v1/EVIDENCE-37.md` maps AC-01–AC-11 to evidence and explicit qualification gaps. The complete V1 workflow is not claimed as qualified.
- `contracts/v1/EVIDENCE-36.md` consolidates the controlled renderer comparison and explicit platform/API/resource limits; the stopped cold-build attempt is preserved.
- `contracts/v1/INSTALL-35.log` records the temporary release installation; `contracts/v1/LAUNCH-35-GTK.log` preserves an inconclusive desktop-entry activation attempt. `contracts/v1/GUI-32-REVISED.log` records the installed native window and its exact preparation/result context.
- GitHub issue #32 records the context mismatch and accepted revised Findings layout. No live GitHub publication writes were performed.

**Blast Radius:** application

Keep the PR in draft until the remaining V1 acceptance evidence is complete.

## 2026-11-06 progress update

- Commit `18aeaca` adds visible Tab/Shift-Tab focus for link actions, changed-file rows, and selectable diff rows/cells. Focused GPUI and full desktop validation passed; evidence and the fresh native launch are in `contracts/v1/EVIDENCE-16-KEYBOARD.md`, `contracts/v1/EVIDENCE-16.md`, and `contracts/v1/VALIDATE-16-FOCUS-CONTROLS.log`. The later `d89a11f` native run confirms changed-file and diff-row focus. All five #16 acceptance criteria are now checked after the user accepted the tested native scope on 2026-11-06. Link-style focus has automated coverage but no native generated-finding fixture yet.
- User-reported changed-file spacing feedback is recorded in `contracts/v1/EVIDENCE-39.md`; no correction or acceptance is claimed.
- #37 remains open and unqualified. Its current gap matrix is `contracts/v1/EVIDENCE-37.md`, and blockers #26, #32, #33, and #36 remain in the qualification path.
- Hosted validation status for `18aeaca` was not yet reported when this update was written. PR remains draft; no review or merge action was taken.


## Current-head native follow-up — 2026-11-06

- `331c39f` records a fresh release-build navigation run on top of `18aeaca`: Home and repository browser rendered, search for `102` returned only #102, and the saved workspace route opened. The PR is closed; no review/publication action was performed. Evidence: `contracts/v1/EVIDENCE-16.md` and `contracts/v1/VALIDATE-16-gui-qualification-2026-11-06.log`.
- Keyboard activation opened the result before the Open empty state could be verified. Lifecycle filtering and link-style focus remain unqualified; the later `d89a11f` native run confirms changed-file and diff-row focus. PR #38 remains draft; no merge or review action was taken.


Commit `51aec37` refreshes `contracts/v1/EVIDENCE-37.md` with the latest local desktop/native evidence and preserves the integrated AC-01–AC-11 gaps. It does not qualify the integrated V1 workflows; keep the PR draft.


Commit `d89a11f` adds the review-entry keyboard focus handoff. Focused GPUI and full desktop validation passed, and a fresh release GUI trial verified Tab traversal through Back, Changes, a changed-file row and a unified diff row, with pinned source selection. Independent Standards/Spec reviews found no findings. The tested #16 UI scope is now accepted. #17 and #37 integrated qualification remain partial; PR #38 stays draft.




## Current-head hosted validation — 2026-11-06

- For `d89a11f83c99dd3601f0086b92fa574a3459b236`, the pull-request Validate run passed ([42242407747](https://github.com/kedarmd/bodh/actions/runs/42242407747)); the push run passed desktop but failed core because the controlled `gh` fixture executable was unavailable ([42242398769](https://github.com/kedarmd/bodh/actions/runs/42242398769)). Both workflows passed for `7910230` ([push 42245364123](https://github.com/kedarmd/bodh/actions/runs/42245364123), [pull request 42245372755](https://github.com/kedarmd/bodh/actions/runs/42245372755)).
- #16 tested product-UI scope is accepted. #37 integrated qualification remains partial; PR #38 remains draft, with no review or merge action taken.



## Current-head native qualification — 2026-11-06

- Commit `7910230` records a fresh current-head native keyboard trial: selecting an unchanged context line and a newly added file loaded the exact pinned Head source. Captures and scope limits are in `contracts/v1/EVIDENCE-17.md`; the integrated matrix is updated in `contracts/v1/EVIDENCE-37.md`. No draft or remote action was created.
- #17 still has both native acceptance criteria unchecked: process restart, scroll/pane restoration, partial-row activation, maximum-length description scrolling, cancellation and unsupported content remain outstanding. The native PR-context trial did restore the selected added file and Head source; details are in `contracts/v1/EVIDENCE-17.md`.
- Hosted push and pull-request validation for `ce67b109ea20f0e050a92af2341cc4991ef9f5af` is currently running ([push 42249366277](https://github.com/kedarmd/bodh/actions/runs/42249366277), [pull request 42249375592](https://github.com/kedarmd/bodh/actions/runs/42249375592)). PR #38 remains draft; no review or merge action was taken.



### Latest qualification update — 2026-11-06

Commit `98b37e73187585750d543df700fa8c7e3948a526` stabilizes the controlled `gh` fixture by consuming the GraphQL request on stdin before returning its response. The `ce67b10` PR desktop run had failed one reconciliation test due to that fixture race; core passed. The fix passes all six focused reconciliation tests and the full local desktop validation, recorded in `contracts/v1/VALIDATE-16-DESKTOP-RACE-FIX.log`. For head be63595, PR-triggered hosted run [42250827294](https://github.com/kedarmd/bodh/actions/runs/42250827294) passed both core and Ubuntu desktop validation. Push-triggered run [42250817564](https://github.com/kedarmd/bodh/actions/runs/42250817564) passed core but its first desktop attempt timed out during Ubuntu dependency installation; the second attempt is in progress. #37 remains open and partial; PR #38 remains draft pending the remaining qualification.


Commit `be63595685953ce8dd18e87445b424b176a84a66` adds a fresh read-only capture of the saved #103 workspace after GitHub confirmed the PR had merged on 2026-11-05. Bodh shows its closed-state banner while retaining the selected diff and pinned source. This is recorded as stale closed-review context, not as a new open-review qualification; #17 and #37 remain open. PR-triggered hosted validation for this commit passed both core and Ubuntu desktop jobs in run 42250827294. The separate push-triggered desktop retry is still running after its first attempt timed out during dependency installation.




## Saved-workspace routing follow-up — 2026-11-06

Commit `99e633d23a8c5f84f1816a52af87ce7114774b88` fixes the repository PR list's “Saved workspace” activation: mouse and keyboard now resume the newest saved preparation, preserving its selected file and source side instead of creating a duplicate. A focused GPUI regression test and full local `CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2 ./scripts/validate desktop` passed; output is recorded in `contracts/v1/VALIDATE-17-RESUME-ROUTE.log`. Issue #17 and the #37 evidence matrix were updated. Hosted validation for this new head is running in [42259527761](https://github.com/kedarmd/bodh/actions/runs/42259527761). The prior duplicate push run [42250817564](https://github.com/kedarmd/bodh/actions/runs/42250817564) recovered and passed both core and Ubuntu desktop checks. The isolated-state native GUI replay is still outstanding. #37 remains open/partial; this PR remains draft and is not ready to merge.


## Native replay result — 2026-11-06

Commit `29c51cef4ef9a81e657823436498d9823afcdafa` records an incomplete isolated-state GUI replay: the release app launched from a copied preferences/SQLite state and reached the #103 PR row (“merged · Saved workspace”), but Tab/Return did not activate it. The trial was stopped before observing resume behavior; it is explicitly not counted as a pass. Capture and raw output are in `contracts/v1/EVIDENCE-17.md` and `contracts/v1/VALIDATE-17-RESUME-GUI.log`. The implementation is covered by the focused GPUI regression and full local desktop validation at `99e633d`. PR-triggered hosted run `42259537486` passed core and desktop on `99e633d`; the duplicate push run and the new-head workflow for `29c51ce` are still finishing. #37 remains open/partial; PR remains draft and is not merge-ready.


## Hosted validation resolution — 2026-11-06

For current head `29c51cef4ef9a81e657823436498d9823afcdafa`, push run [42260503568](https://github.com/kedarmd/bodh/actions/runs/42260503568) passed core and Ubuntu desktop. PR run [42260513652](https://github.com/kedarmd/bodh/actions/runs/42260513652) initially had one transient failure starting a temporary fake `gh` executable in `gh_prerequisite::tests::preflight_reports_the_installed_cli_version`; the targeted test passed twice locally, and rerunning the failed hosted job passed. The saved-workspace regression test passed in hosted desktop validation. This resolves the validation run; it does not close #37's integrated workflow gaps. Keep this PR draft.


## User-assisted saved-review resume — 2026-11-06

Commit `d572f82` records completion of the isolated-state repository-list replay. The user clicked **Open review** for merged #103 and confirmed it worked. The copied preference state afterward retained the original preparation ID, `CastLauncherView.qml`, Base source side, split mode, and the same count of 10 #103 entries; no duplicate preparation was created. Keyboard focus on the PR browser was not verified. See `contracts/v1/EVIDENCE-17.md` and `contracts/v1/EVIDENCE-37.md`. Hosted validation for this evidence-only commit is running. #37 remains open/partial; keep PR #38 draft.


## Hosted validation — evidence commit `d572f82`

Both workflow events passed for current head `d572f821be731f0750782eed20007ac26e435ce0`: push [42269101714](https://github.com/kedarmd/bodh/actions/runs/42269101714) and pull request [42269110981](https://github.com/kedarmd/bodh/actions/runs/42269110981), with core and Ubuntu desktop jobs green. The user-assisted native saved-workspace replay is recorded in `contracts/v1/EVIDENCE-17.md` and `contracts/v1/EVIDENCE-37.md`. #37 remains open/partial; keep this PR draft pending the broader integrated qualification.



## Current head qualification update — 2026-11-07

Code head `f9339e2` contains the #39 screen-local row spacing adjustment and #15 nested-discussion timeout fixture calibration. The controlled delayed page remains 3 seconds; the original 100 ms test deadline passed 6/10 runs, while the 1 second fixture deadline passed 10/10, the discussion suite passed 15/15, and the complete local desktop runner passed. Hosted validation for `f9339e2` passed in [push 42319422941](https://github.com/kedarmd/bodh/actions/runs/42319422941) and [pull request 42319426176](https://github.com/kedarmd/bodh/actions/runs/42319426176).

The #39 follow-up has fresh dark and light split captures at 1904×1020 ([dark](https://github.com/kedarmd/bodh/blob/integration/1-bodh-v1/contracts/v1/evidence/issue-39-spacing-2026-11-07/dark-split-1904x1020.png), [light](https://github.com/kedarmd/bodh/blob/integration/1-bodh-v1/contracts/v1/evidence/issue-39-spacing-2026-11-07/light-split-1904x1020.png)). User acceptance remains pending; the earlier 947×505 focus/resize matrix was not repeated.

A later hosted run exposed an intermittent fake-GitHub-CLI process-start test failure on both push and pull-request jobs. Commit `ce67aed` switched fake executables to unique `TempDir` fixtures and used a 3-second test-only deadline; push validation passed and pull-request validation passed after rerunning its failed desktop job. Commits `e209ec6` and `11ba28a` combine duplicate successful-spawn checks and bound the failure diagnostic to test status only. These changes do not alter production behavior. The consolidated test passed 10/10 local invocations and the full local desktop runner passed; full logs are in `contracts/v1/AC-GH-PREFLIGHT-REPEAT-2026-11-07.log`, `contracts/v1/VALIDATE-GH-PREFLIGHT-CONSOLIDATED-2026-11-07.log`, `contracts/v1/AC-GH-PREFLIGHT-CONSOLIDATED-REPEAT-2026-11-07-REVIEW-FIX.log`, and `contracts/v1/VALIDATE-GH-PREFLIGHT-CONSOLIDATED-REVIEW-FIX-2026-11-07.log`. Independent Standards and Spec reviews found no actionable issues; the Spec pass noted there is no dedicated slow-child timeout test.

Both hosted workflows for current head `11ba28a` passed: [push 42325947541](https://github.com/kedarmd/bodh/actions/runs/42325947541) and [pull request 42325949661](https://github.com/kedarmd/bodh/actions/runs/42325949661), with core and Ubuntu desktop green. #37 remains open and partial, PR #38 remains draft, and no review/merge action was performed.


### 2026-11-07 integrated qualification update

Commit `4e58256` adds deterministic coverage for the native GitHub CLI preflight timeout controller. The test verifies timeout reporting and the kill/wait cleanup calls without adding another spawned process to the parallel desktop suite. The first shell-backed timeout fixture failed to start in a hosted PR desktop run; that failed trial remains preserved at [42327180962](https://github.com/kedarmd/bodh/actions/runs/42327180962). The corrected code passed local full desktop validation and both hosted workflows: [push 42328085693](https://github.com/kedarmd/bodh/actions/runs/42328085693) and [pull request 42328088464](https://github.com/kedarmd/bodh/actions/runs/42328088464). Evidence is in `contracts/v1/EVIDENCE-33.md` and `contracts/v1/EVIDENCE-37.md`; the raw local log is `contracts/v1/VALIDATE-GH-PREFLIGHT-TIMEOUT-DETERMINISTIC-FINAL-2026-11-07.log`.

The evidence pointer refresh is commit `fcf2cba`; both hosted workflows passed: [push 42328749959](https://github.com/kedarmd/bodh/actions/runs/42328749959) and [pull request 42328753745](https://github.com/kedarmd/bodh/actions/runs/42328753745). This timeout test update does not complete #37. The integrated manual/agent workflow, provider exhaustion and authorization, complete cross-operation recovery and concurrency, large-review support/performance limits, and remaining native interaction checks are still open. #37 remains open and this PR remains draft. The #39 spacing follow-up still awaits the user’s visual acceptance.
